Control, evidence and decision vocabulary

After this lesson you can:
  • Use fact, evidence, decision and event precisely
  • Distinguish maker-checker, override, waiver and exception
  • Specify lineage and replay

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. The core chain
  2. Human-control terms
  3. Failure and replay
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. The core chain

A fact is a typed assertion with source and time.

Evidence supports a fact.

Policy evaluates facts into a decision.

An authorised command applies a state transition.

The resulting event records what changed.

Audit lineage connects all five; a screenshot or final status alone cannot reconstruct the chain.

2. Human-control terms

Maker-checker separates preparation and approval.

Referral routes a case because policy requires judgement.

Override changes a policy outcome within explicit authority.

Waiver releases a requirement or amount.

Exception records departure and expiry.

Committee is an approval body with quorum and conflict rules.

These labels must drive permissions and evidence, not decorate a task.

3. Failure and replay

Fail closed means missing, invalid, stale or unreachable inputs land on the restrictive path.

Idempotency prevents duplicate effects when a request repeats.

Replay re-evaluates with the exact policy and facts.

Reconciliation compares independently derived records and routes differences to repair.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-IAM-SOD — Need-based access and segregation give control terms operational force.
  • RBI-IT-GRC — Auditability and controlled processing require lineage.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Where this lives in LoanOS

  • Capability AUD-001 — Tamper-evident audit lineage.
  • Capability UWG-019 — Decision trace and replay.
  • Capability LWS-002 — Maker-checker workflow.
  • Capability ACC-003 — Idempotent event ingestion.

Retrieval practice

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. Which item supports a fact but is not itself the policy outcome?

  1. Evidence
  2. Decision
  3. State transition
  4. Override
Reveal answer and reasoning

A. Evidence supports a fact; policy produces the decision.
